title: Verify: Manifest validator unit tests
description: Unit tests for validator results, error paths and duplicate ids.
acceptance_criteria: A valid manifest returns ok true and an invalid one returns ok false with the field path
Duplicate ids are reported and non-object input does not throw

steps.action: Create tests importing parseManifest, parseAsset from ../src/assets/manifest: (1) {version:1,assets:[valid image]} gives ok true and data.assets[0].id equals 'bookshelf'; (2) asset with dimensions.width 0 gives ok false and an error containing 'assets.0.dimensions.width'; (3) two assets with id 'bed' gives ok false and an error containing 'duplicate asset id: bed'; (4) inputs null, 'x', 42 each give ok false and do not throw; (5) parseAsset of valid image gives ok true
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/manifestValidate.test.ts
